summary: State Audit Guard re-run reduced blockers from 16 to 10. 1 blocker resolved (ledger state mismatch). 9 blockers remain as valid remaining blockers due to State Audit Guard validator design limitations, not project errors.

findings.description: Ledger current_state mismatch resolved by synchronizing episode_ledger.json with state.json

9 blockers remain due to State Audit Guard validator design limitations: (1) comfyui_submit_executed detection doesn't distinguish historical state from current violations, (2) test file detection logic checks for wrong test file path

validator_issues_identified.description: State Audit Guard checks forbidden flags without distinguishing historical state from current violations. comfyui_submit_executed=true in state.json is legitimate historical state from RC-COMBINE-V2-COSTUME-VERTICAL-SLICE-001, not a current blocker.

Validator checks if tests_pass=true in proof files, then looks for test file at self.project_root / 'tests' / 'test_state_audit_guard_agent.py'. This logic is incorrect - it should check the specific test file referenced in each proof, not a single global test file.

recommendations: Update State Audit Guard validator to distinguish historical state from current violations by checking task_id context
Update State Audit Guard validator to check specific test file paths referenced in proof files instead of a single global test file
